response.original_title: Edmund Soohoo: The Heart of Chinatown
response.overview: A heartfelt portrait of Edmund Soohoo, a visionary organizer and beloved figure in Los Angeles Chinatown. From co-founding the iconic Firecracker Run to mentoring generations of community leaders, Edmund’s story is told through the reflections of those who witnessed his commitment firsthand. This film honors his lasting legacy and the spirit of collective care that defined his life’s work.
